plugins.description: Watch several video feeds at once in one tiled wall.
Search and rescue incidents, markers, photos and tracks, shared over TAK Server.
Stream this phone's camera to the map as a live video feed.
Keep several ATAK profiles and switch between them.
Bookmark places on the map and jump back to them.
Send units to an incident and see how long each one will take to get there.
Play a time-stamped KML track back on the map as it happened.
Keeps reporting your position to your TAK server when ATAK is closed.
Send markers, data packages and files to nearby ATAK devices with no server.
